posts.text: Yesterday I had the opportunity to attend #SLXCA2025 at Western University 🎉 It was inspiring to connect with fellow Western University , University of Waterloo , and McMaster University Schulich Leader Scholarships recipients. I got to hear from incredible Schulich alumni, Dr. Eric Morse and Dr. Gordon Osiniki who shared so many valuable insights that left me motivated and excited for what’s ahead. Grateful for the chance to be part of such a supportive and driven community!

I'm thrilled to share that I will be attending Western University this fall, pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with an Ivey Business School at Western University AEO status and the Schulich Leader Scholarships.
